notes.title: Hotfix
notes.notes: Fixed an error with the "Maker" level.

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.notes: Fixed an error where game would sometimes crash on the death of the oilboy.

notes.title: Major balancing improvements & bug fixes
notes.notes:
-fixed bug with the big laser towers range/origin
-the light laser tower now costs half as much for the AI to create
-Units now have an upkeep cost; receiver $1 a sec, halfback $2 a sec, & oilboy $3 a sec. Be careful, this can stack and crush you if you don’t have the eco to support your units.

notes.title: Improved sound setting + bug fixes
notes.notes: Added sliders for both sound effects and music, and fixed a couple bugs.

notes.title: Fixed and issue with levels
notes.notes: Fixed an issue where certain levels could not be unlocked.
